references.text: En-gannim is mentioned again as one of the Levitical cities given to the Gershonite clan from the tribe of Issachar.
En-gannim is also mentioned as a city in Judah, showing that several cities could have the same name in different tribal territories.
Beth-Haran (a similar name to Beth-Pazzez) illustrates the pattern of 'Beth-' names for cities, meaning 'house' in Hebrew place names.
